designationHistory.name: Cherokee National Game Refuge No. 1
designationHistory.indexText: President Coolidge set aside Cherokee National Game Refuges Numbers One and Two on Weeks Act lands of the Cherokee National Forest in Tennessee and Georgia.

authority.citation: Proclamation of Aug. 5, 1924, 43 Stat. 1964 (under Act of Aug. 11, 1916, 39 Stat. 446, 476)

designationHistory.note: Proclamation 2105 of Oct. 22, 1934 redrew the refuge's boundaries; that boundary change is not listed.
